verdict.rationale: Through its included registered-agent service, VPM receives service of process, legal notices and state correspondence, and scans served legal documents for online availability the same day. That is a documented expedited path for part of this story. Its generic automation rules are not documented to flag or prioritize government or legal senders, and nothing shows IRS mail arriving at the ordinary mailbox gets any special handling. Missing for 10: flagging or priority tagging of IRS/government mail in the virtual mailbox, deadline alerts or notifications for legal/compliance items, documented sender-based automation rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
